name: Khalid Mohammed Al-Harbi
title: Senior Project Manager
summary: Results-driven Senior Project Manager with 12+ years of experience delivering complex infrastructure and construction projects in Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Fluent in organizational leadership, digital transformation and M&A technology integration. Board member and advisor to several regional technology organizations. Proven expertise in managing project portfolios valued at SAR 150M+, stakeholder management, contract negotiation (FIDIC/NEC), lean construction, value engineering, HSE excellence, and PMIS systems. Seeking to leverage program management expertise to deliver Saudi's national development objectives.

Directed SAR 250M substation construction project for Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), coordinating 45 subcontractors and achieving 99.2% quality compliance score on first-time inspections
Implemented Lean Construction methodology across project portfolio, reducing waste by 28% and improving productivity by 32%, resulting in SAR 15M cost avoidance over 4 years
Achieved 4.2 million man-hours with zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI), earning SEC HSE Excellence Award (2023) and establishing new company safety benchmark
Developed and mentored team of 12 Saudi project engineers through structured development program, with 8 achieving PMP certification and 3 promoted to Project Manager roles (Saudization initiative)
